description: Java Spring MVC controller class 'ReferenceController' handling reference data endpoints such as provinces, country names, zone names, credit card dates, and months of the year.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling reference data endpoints such as provinces, country names, zone names, credit card dates, and months of the year.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve provinces (zones) for a given country code and language, returning JSON data.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a country given its country code, considering the request's language context.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Returns the name of a zone given its zone code, considering the request's language context.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Provides a list of upcoming years for credit card expiration, cached for performance.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Provides a list of months (01 to 12), cached for performance.
